beverloo_fit — DRIVE granular op

• 数据种类:signal × signal × scalar × scalar → table

• 调用: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.beverloo_fit(D0, W, d: 'float', bulk_density: 'float', k: 'float' = 1.4, g: 'float' = 9.80665) -> 'dict'(要直接调用实现,import granular; granular.beverloo_fit(D0, W, d: 'float', bulk_density: 'float', k: 'float' = 1.4, g: 'float' = 9.80665) -> 'dict';从台账取用则 opsdrive.get("beverloo_fit"))

用法

用最小二乘将 log W = log(C ρ_b √g) + n log(D₀ − k d) 拟合到排出速率序列 W_i(D0_i)，返回指数 n 与系数 C(真值 n = 2.5、C ≈ 0.58)。返回：n、C、rms_log(对数残差)。Raises ValueError：点少于 3 个 / 存在 D0 ≤ k d 的点 / W ≤ 0。
